title: Static Sweep Brace Hand Drill
description: New complete static sweep-brace woodworking hand drill: a continuous offset steel crank connects the lower faceted chuck and fixed finite-blunt twist bit to the upper axial wood palm head. A whole elongated wood grip surrounds the offset vertical crank run. This is a complete open sweep hand tool, not the old column drill press, motor or steam crank-flywheel bench scaled down. All geometry new, three opaque constant PBR materials, metre units and XY centred ground origin. Fixed display only, no rotation, ratchet, grip-bearing fit, drilling, sharpness, torque, ergonomics, manufacturing or safety claim.
